SWORN WITNESS STATEMENT (Under Section 164 Cr.P.C.)
Witness Name: Ramesh Chand | Occupation: Senior Security Guard | Location: Tech Vault Facility

1. STATEMENT DETAILS:
"I was on duty at the primary gate monitor desk on the night of 01-Sept-2026. At approximately 02:10 AM, I saw a person matching Sameer Verma walk past the biometric barrier using a master keycard. He was wearing a dark jacket with the hood pulled up, but I clearly recognized his face and distinct scar across his left cheek when he turned towards camera B4. At 02:22 AM, I heard a loud gunshot from server block B4. Seconds later, the same person ran out carrying a heavy pelican case, entered a dark sedan, and sped away through Exit 4."

documents.extractedText:
POLICE INVESTIGATION & INTERROGATION BRIEF
Case ID: CASE-2026-8891 | Investigating Officer: Inspector Vikram Sharma

1. SUSPECT TRACKING LOG:
Automatic Number Plate Recognition (ANPR) cameras located at Cyber Park Expressway Exit 4 captured dark grey sedan (#DL-09-CB-4491) passing at 02:31 AM, traveling towards the western toll plaza. Cell tower triangulation logs for mobile number registered under suspect Sameer Verma (+91 98210-44910) showed active handoffs matching the vehicle trajectory between 02:15 AM and 03:10 AM.

2. WITNESS INTERROGATION - FACILITY GUARD:
Security Guard Ramesh Chand (ID #SG-441) was interrogated at 06:00 AM. Guard Chand stated under sworn oath that at 02:10 AM he observed suspect Sameer Verma bypass the secondary biometric gate using a master override keycard. Guard Chand confirmed suspect Verma had a distinct facial scar across his left cheek and carried a heavy pelican case upon exiting.

3. INVESTIGATIVE SUMMARY & NEXT STEPS:
Physical evidence recovered from suspect residence during search warrant execution includes one Glock-17 9mm pistol (Serial #GL-88392) hidden beneath bedroom floorboards and an encrypted laptop containing wallet backup files. Requesting immediate forensic ballistics matching and DNA profiling.

TACTICAL RAID & SEIZURE MEMORANDUM
Case ID: CASE-2026-4412 | Location: International Docking Terminal 3, Hangar 9

1. SEIZURE SUMMARY:
Joint tactical operation conducted by Special Crime Branch resulted in the interception of a commercial shipping container (ID #CONT-8891-X). Physical inventory confirmed the seizure of 45.4 kilograms of high-purity contraband MDMA base packaged in vacuum-sealed industrial pouches.

2. RECOVERED WEAPONRY & ARRESTS:
Two unregistered automatic submachine guns (Serials #SMG-991A, #SMG-991B) loaded with 30-round high-capacity magazines were seized from two armed suspects arrested on site. Suspects identified as Carlos Mendez and Rajiv Kapoor. Chemical purity analysis confirmed 94.2% pharmaceutical-grade purity.

documents.title: DNA Profile & Touch Epigenetic Analysis Report
documents.extractedText:
FORENSIC BIOLOGY & DNA TYPING REPORT
Lab Ref: FSL-DNA-2026-4412 | Forensic Analyst: Dr. Sunita Rao

1. TOUCH DNA EXTRACTION (EXHIBIT B2):
Touch DNA swabs collected from the manual safety catch and slide serrations of seized Glock-17 pistol (Serial #GL-88392) were amplified using 15 Short Tandem Repeat (STR) genetic markers.

2. STR PROFILE MATCH RESULTS:
The extracted DNA profile yielded a complete 15-loci male match corresponding exactly to suspect Sameer Verma (Reference Sample #DNA-SV992).
- Loci Match Count: 15 out of 15 fully concordant markers (D3S1358, vWA, FGA, D8S1179, D21S11, D18S51, D5S818, D13S317, D7S820, TPOX, TH01, CSF1PO, D16S539, D2S1338, D19S433).
- Random Match Probability (RMP): 1 in 4.8 billion in the general population.
- Epigenetic analysis confirmed fresh epithelial cell deposition within 18 hours of seizure.

DIGITAL FORENSICS & MEMORY DUMP ANALYSIS REPORT
Lab Ref: FSL-DIG-2026-1102 | Digital Examiner: Dr. Sunita Rao

1. VOLATILE MEMORY FORENSICS:
Volatile RAM image extracted from suspect Sameer Verma's seized laptop (Serial #LT-99410) revealed an active unallocated memory page containing an unencrypted AES-256 private key fragment.

2. CRYPTO SIPHONING BLOCKCHAIN TRAIL:
Reconstructed transaction logs mapped the illicit transfer of $4,250,000 USD equivalent in cryptocurrency from Tech Vault Master Address (0x742d35Cc6634C0532925a3b844Bc454e4438f44e) to an offshore mixer wallet (0x8891F44e991823901A7e829C1102Aa4438f) executed at 02:33 AM (18 minutes post-incident). VPN IP logs confirm execution via an exit node matching suspect Verma's personal VPN account.

IN THE HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE
Bail Application No. 8891/2026 | State Response Filed by Senior Prosecutor Rajesh Verma

1. OPPOSITION TO BAIL:
The State strongly opposes the grant of bail to accused Sameer Verma on the following compelling legal grounds:
- Severe Flight Risk: Accused holds active possession of $4.2M in siphoned cryptocurrency transferred to offshore mixer wallets, providing immense financial resources to abscond.
- Threat of Witness Tampering: Key eyewitness Security Guard Ramesh Chand has received anonymous threatening calls since suspect's arrest.
- Immutable Chain of Evidence: Overwhelming forensic proof including 100% ballistics and DNA match anchored on the SākshyaChain audit ledger.

ORDER OF COGNIZANCE & JUDICIAL REMAND
Special Sessions Court | Presiding Magistrate: Justice P. K. Mukherjee

1. COGNIZANCE TAKEN:
Formal judicial cognizance is hereby taken of Charge Sheet #00492/2026 filed against accused Sameer Verma under IPC Sections 302, 392, and IT Act Section 66D. Prima facie evidence including microscopic ballistics striation match and 15-loci DNA match is deemed sufficient to initiate trial.

2. REMAND & CHAIN OF CUSTODY DIRECTIVE:
Accused Sameer Verma is remanded to high-security judicial custody until trial commencement. All physical exhibits (Exhibits B1, B2, GL-88392) and digital vault records must remain locked and cross-verified on the SākshyaChain audit ledger.
